PROPER - a proper synth for house music (macOS, Apple Silicon and Intel)
https://github.com/VouDoo/proper-synth

What's in here
  Proper.app    the standalone app
  Proper.clap   the CLAP plugin
  Proper.vst3   the VST3 plugin

Plugins
  Copy them into your plugin folders, then rescan in your DAW:
    Proper.clap  ->  ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/CLAP/
    Proper.vst3  ->  ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/
  (In Finder: Go > Go to Folder..., paste the path. Create the folder if
  it doesn't exist.)

Standalone app
  Drag Proper.app into Applications and open it.

"Proper can't be opened" / "is damaged"?
  These builds aren't signed by Apple, so macOS blocks them at first.
  Open Terminal and run, for each file you copied:
    xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/CLAP/Proper.clap
    xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/Proper.vst3
    xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Proper.app
  Then open it again.

Licence
  Proper's source code is MIT-licensed (see LICENSE). These compiled builds
  include GPLv3-licensed code (nih-plug's VST3 bindings), so the builds are
  shared under the GPLv3 (see LICENSE-GPL-3.0.txt). The full source is at
  the address above.
